subject: statistics: refresh stats concurrently (#64034)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent with focus on stats refresh/init concurrency and session/GC interactions. The change removes the shared non-concurrent init-stats session context and instead runs InitStats/InitStatsLite via syssession pool sessions (with optional wait/cancel behavior to register internal sessions for GC blocking), and starts multiple stats sync-load subworkers based on configured concurrency; added tests cover concurrent REFRESH STATS and cancellation when session manager is absent. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, consistency, or session/txn/GC hazards found in the touched executor/planner/session/statistics behavior.
